# Show Studio diagnostics<AvailableFrom v="4.0.543" />

Show a movable diagnostics window in the Studio with the number of audio iterators created, open Mediabunny sinks, buffering handles created, and buffering states triggered. Creation counts reset when the page reloads. The buffering handle count can also be reset in the window. While open, the window records buffering events with their contributing handles and lets you reveal the owning layers in the timeline. Setting this option on the command line disables the corresponding Studio settings switch. Defaults to `false`.

## CLI flag

```text
--show-diagnostics
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setShowDiagnostics(true);
```
